CHARACTERISTICS OF GROUP 9 (9, 18, 27, 36, 45, 54, 63, 72, 81, 90, 99)
People associated with Number 9 may appear arrogant on the surface, while inwardly lacking confidence and fearing rejection. They are determined but may appear wilful or reckless to others. They can act impulsively, which may later lead to regret. They are generous, straightforward, and sincere, and although they may become angry quickly, they can also let go of anger quickly. They often expect others to be as sincere as they are, yet may encounter people they perceive as insincere or fraudulent, which can cause distress when their good deeds are not rewarded.
Life:
The number 99 indicates success. People associated with this number will receive energy and help from the cosmos and luck undreamed of. They have a good sense of premonition, are talented and have faith in things mystical, which they frequently encounter. Number 99 is a favourable number, but it must come from the summation of favourable numbers relating to name or surname to be beneficial to life. If connected with an unfavourable number the positive influence will be cancelled. Number 99 summed together equals 18, representing misfortune bringing disappointment in all matters of love.
Be Wary Of:
Love & Family:
Females: Disappointment in love (that is slow to marry, remaining single, divorced or separated, widowed early, mistress to a married man, relationship with a divorcee).
Males: Disappointment in love (that is unmarried, separated or divorced, partner missing or dead), having many lovers.

CHARACTERISTICS OF GROUP 1 (1, 10, 19, 28, 37, 46, 55, 64, 73, 82, 91, 100)
People associated with Number 1 are self-confident, intellectually sharp, decisive, quick to learn, steadfast, ambitious, and original. They dislike being subordinate or being forced, taught, nagged, fussed over, or repeatedly criticized. They are gentle and sympathetic and often like to help those who are weak or in need. Because they tend to take other people's problems upon themselves, they should be careful not to make those problems their own or spend their energy on situations that bring difficulties without meaningful benefit. They enjoy talking and teaching and may sometimes be perceived as grumblers. They take honor seriously and can be quick to take offence when they feel disrespected.
Life:
This is a favourable number influencing a person to be ambitious, but one should set limits and know when to be satisfied and not be over-ambitious, as the influence of number 0, Uranus and can have the effect of increasing the power of number 100. However if 100 results from the combination of unfavourable first and surname numbers, it will be changed to number 10, causing a life marked by unhappiness and disappointments causing them to be chronic worriers. Household members or family may bring about problems and unhappiness. They may have to carry burdens of duty and work and maybe the burden of debt.
